messages:
Alex: Morning team — quick async check. What did you do yesterday / blockers / plan for today? Post PRs or quick asks. I'll be available for quick pairing until 11:30 PT. @infra-bot please hold any production deploys until migrations are green.
Maria: Yesterday: finished schema tweaks for user_sessions and started the staging migrate. Blocker: staging OOMs on large tables. Today: trying chunked migrate + temp-index trick. Need help with parallelization from Kevin. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infer/pull/4217
Kevin: On it — can pair after 10:30 PT. I'll take a look at Maria's PR now. Also need review on my kv-cache micro-optim (PR #4210) if anyone has bandwidth.
Jamie: Heads up — I'm on-call til 3pm but can join a quick pairing at 10:45. If migration needs downtime we should target 2:15pm PT for a short window. I also saw a note that the autoscale policy may conflict with long-running migrations.
infra-bot: deploybot: Staging deploy for user-svc is queued. Status: blocked by migration lock. Action: run '/deploy override' only after lead approval. See pipeline ID: pkg-3921
Maria: Thanks — starting chunked migration now with batch_size=2000, will post logs here if it errors. tagging @Kevin
Alex: If it OOMs again flip to batch_size=1000 and enable tmp-indexing (reindex into temp table then swap). See internal doc: https://wiki.redwood.internal/migrations#temp-index
Kevin: Reviewing Maria's PR now — should have LGTM in ~30m. Also adding rollback steps to the ticket (db dump + restore plan, and a quick feature-flag rollback).
Jamie: If we need to cancel the staging deploy I can pause the pipeline and notify QA. :thumbsup:
Maria: Update: chunked migrate started, first batch completed successfully. Running batch 2 now, will update in ~15m. :white_check_mark:
